changeSet.author: nin
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS features jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{ "spell_loadout": true, "quests": true, "items": true, "char_progression": true, "audio": true, "gamepad": true, "mouse": true, "keyboard": true, "touch": true }'::jsonb;

changeSet.author: nin
changeSet.sql: UPDATE games SET features = features || '{"spell_loadout": false, "quests": false, "items": false, "char_progression": false}'::jsonb WHERE slug = 'dodecahedron';

changeSet.author: nin
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO input_event_kinds (kind, description) VALUES ('gamepad', 'USB / Bluetooth gamepad — buttons, axes, hat-pad, vibration ack.'), ('mouse', 'Pointer device — motion, buttons, wheel.'), ('keyboard', 'Physical keyboard — keydown / keyup with modifier mask.'), ('touch', 'Touch surface — gesture phases (down / move / up / cancel).'), ('audio', 'Audio playback events — start / stop / volume / device-change.'), ('world', 'Game-emitted world events — spawn / despawn / state-change.'), ('control', 'Legacy JRPG controller commands (movement / cast / interact).') ON CONFLICT (kind) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: nin
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO game_event_support (game_slug, event_kind, event_type, direction) SELECT 'three-wizards', kind, type, 'both' FROM input_event_types ON CONFLICT (game_slug, event_kind, event_type) DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO game_event_support (game_slug, event_kind, event_type, direction) SELECT 'dodecahedron', kind, type, 'both' FROM input_event_types WHERE kind IN ('gamepad','mouse','keyboard','touch','audio','world') ON CONFLICT (game_slug, event_kind, event_type) DO NOTHING;
